description: Immutable audit trail module. record_event(event_type,actor,target_server_id,action,outcome,details={})->str: writes to audit_log table via ws_write {event_id=uuid,event_type,actor,target_server_id,action,outcome,details_json,timestamp,immutable=True}. get_server_history(server_id)->list: full chronological history for one server. get_actor_history(actor)->list: all actions by one actor. export_audit_csv(start_date,end_date)->str: CSV of audit log. Used by approval_workflow for all decisions and by all agents making verdict changes. No daemon, utility module.
